title: Great for beginners
content: Love this app! Short workouts, no equipment needed. But the paywall pops up too often, very annoying when I just want free training.

title: Too many subscription prompts
content: Workout quality is fine, but every 2 minutes it asks me to subscribe. Almost impossible to use free version normally.

title: Perfect home exercise
content: Good for women who exercise at home. Clear animation guidance. Wish there were more free training plans.

title: Videos lag on iPhone
content: When doing workout the animation lags and stutters. Phone gets hot quickly. Hope dev can fix performance problem.

title: Good but buggy
content: Some exercise timers count wrong. Sometimes it skips movement. Otherwise content is really helpful.

title: Crashes after update
content: App crashes on launch since v13.22. Reinstalled twice, still broken. Losing all my streak data.

title: Subscription charged twice
content: Got billed $49.99 twice in one week. Support hasn't replied to 3 emails. This is theft.

title: Can't cancel subscription
content: No cancel button in app or website. Had to go through Apple support. Deliberately dark pattern.

title: Lost 8 months of progress
content: Update wiped all my workout history. No cloud backup option. Completely unacceptable for paid app.

title: Ads during workout
content: Free version shows video ads mid-exercise. Ruins flow entirely. Used to be ad-free before paywall push.

title: Battery hog
content: Drains 40% battery in 45min workout. Phone overheats. Other fitness apps don't have this issue.

title: Watch sync dead
content: Apple Watch companion app hasn't synced in 3 weeks. Tried reset, reinstall, nothing works.

title: False advertising
content: Store page says 'free meal plans' but all require premium. Misleading description, feel scammed.

title: Unusable on cellular
content: Pages take 20+ seconds to load on LTE. Works fine on WiFi but useless at gym with bad signal.

title: New UI is terrible
content: Redesign hid all settings. Can't find timer preferences or notification controls anymore.

title: Step counter inaccurate
content: Shows 15k steps when I walked 4k. Compared with pedometer and Apple Health. Way off.

title: Still no dark mode
content: Using at night blinds me. Every competitor has dark mode in 2026. Why not this app?

title: Export gives corrupt file
content: CSV download produces unreadable file. Need data for nutritionist appointment. Frustrating.

title: Notification hell
content: Gets 12+ push notifications daily despite turning most off. Can't fully disable meal reminders.

title: Overpriced for features
content: $79.99/year but missing water tracking, sleep log, body measurements. Basic stuff absent.

title: Charts display wrong
content: Weekly progress bars overlap on iPhone SE. Labels cut off. Unreadable on small screens.

title: Can't delete account
content: No account deletion option anywhere. GDPR violation? Want my personal data erased completely.

title: Rest timer pauses randomly
content: Timer stops during rest periods without input. Have to manually restart each set. Breaks focus.

title: Missing basic features
content: No water intake tracker, no sleep logging, no waist/hip measurements. Feels incomplete.

title: Decent but unstable
content: Core tracking works but crashes weekly. Hope next update fixes stability before I switch apps.

title: Free tier is okay
content: Basic workouts accessible without paying. Meal database small though, search often returns nothing.

title: AI coach is generic
content: Loved the idea of AI coaching but responses are copy-paste advice. Not personalized to my goals.

title: Accurate but outdated UI
content: Tracking precision is good. Interface looks like 2018 design. Needs modern refresh badly.

title: Average compared to peers
content: Does the job but lacks community challenges and social features that Fitbit offers.

title: Wouldn't pay for premium
content: Free version covers basics. Premium price unjustified when MyFitnessPal does more for less.

title: Repetitive meal suggestions
content: Same 10 meals rotate weekly. Need vegan/keto filters and more variety in recipe database.

title: Support responded quickly
content: Had login issue, support replied within 20 hours. Appreciate the responsiveness. App itself is meh.

title: Barcode scanner fails often
content: Great workout library but nutrition tracking clunky. Scanner misses 70% of grocery items.

title: Almost perfect
content: Fix crashes and add dark mode, I'd rate 5 stars. Core functionality is solid otherwise.

title: Reliable daily tracker
content: Used 3 months consistently. Reports help maintain accountability. Minor bugs but overall dependable.

title: Meal plans save time
content: Premium worth it for meal planning alone. Saved 5hrs/week on grocery prep. Lost 10lbs in 6 weeks.

title: AI advice actually useful
content: Unlike other apps, AI coach gave specific form corrections based on my feedback. Impressed.

title: Watch sync flawless now
content: Recent update fixed Apple Watch sync. Data transfers instantly. Was skeptical but works perfectly.

title: Devs listen to feedback
content: Requested barcode fix in review, shipped in next update. Rare to see teams respond this fast.

title: Best fitness app tried
content: Clean interface, accurate tracking, responsive support. Tried 8 apps over 2 years, this wins.

title: Transformed my habits
content: Down 22lbs in 3 months. Meal tracking made calorie deficit sustainable. Life-changing honestly.

title: Everything just works
content: Syncs perfectly, intuitive navigation, massive food database. No bloat, no crashes. 10/10 experience.

title: Premium justified
content: AI coaching feels personal, not generic. Helped break 4-month plateau. Worth every dollar.

title: Support resolved billing fast
content: Double charge issue fixed in under 1 hour via live chat. Exceptional service for app company.

title: Essential for serious training
content: Weekly insights revealed recovery patterns I missed. Optimized training load based on data.

title: Zero issues in 6 months
content: Daily user since November. No crashes, perfect sync, beautiful charts. Best investment ever.

title: Reports incredibly detailed
content: Weekly summaries show trends I never noticed. Helped adjust nutrition timing for better energy.

title: Simple and effective
content: No unnecessary features, just what you need. Performance smooth even on older iPhone 12.

title: Seamless Health integration
content: All data flows both ways with Apple Health automatically. No manual entry needed. Perfect.

title: Marathon prep game changer
content: Training plans adapted to my pace improvements automatically. Finished PR by 8 minutes. Incredible.
